content.text: {"primary_meaning":"God-given teaching or guidance that reveals how people should believe and live—especially divine law, wisdom, and moral direction. “Instruction” is generally treated as a direct concept rather than as a symbol with one fixed hidden meaning.","primary_basis":["Psalm 1:1–2 — the righteous delight in the LORD’s instruction/law and meditate on it.","Psalm 19:7–11 — the law or instruction of the LORD restores, enlightens, and warns.","Psalm 119:1–16, 97–105 — divine instruction directs righteous conduct and functions as a light for one’s path.","Proverbs 1:2–8; 4:1–13 — instruction communicates wisdom, knowledge, correction, and the fear of the LORD.","Deuteronomy 6:1–9 — God’s commands are to be taught continually and embodied in covenant life.","2 Timothy 3:14–17 — Scripture provides teaching, correction, training, and preparation for good works."],"alternatives":[{"meaning":"Discipline or corrective training, particularly the Hebrew concept of musar: instruction that forms character through warning, rebuke, or chastening.","basis":["Proverbs 3:11–12","Proverbs 12:1","Proverbs 15:31–33","Hebrews 12:5–11"],"prominence":"common"},{"meaning":"The Torah or Mosaic covenant law specifically, rather than divine teaching in the broader sense.","basis":["Deuteronomy 4:44","Joshua 1:7–8","Nehemiah 8:1–8","Psalm 78:1–7"],"prominence":"common"},{"meaning":"Authoritative Christian doctrine or apostolic teaching entrusted to the church.","basis":["Matthew 28:19–20","Acts 2:42","1 Timothy 4:11–16","2 Timothy 1:13–14","Titus 2:1"],"prominence":"common"},{"meaning":"The inward guidance of the Holy Spirit, who teaches believers and leads them into truth.","basis":["John 14:26","John 16:13","Romans 8:14","1 John 2:20–27"],"prominence":"minority"},{"meaning":"A symbolic “lamp,” “light,” “path,” or “seed” that illuminates and produces spiritual life. These are metaphors associated with divine instruction, not a fixed meaning of the term itself.","basis":["Proverbs 6:23","Psalm 119:105","Luke 8:11","James 1:21–25"],"prominence":"minority"}],"has_settled_consensus":false,"confidence":"high","notes":"There is broad agreement that instruction denotes teaching, guidance, or formation grounded in divine revelation. However, there is no single settled symbolic interpretation independent of context: the term may refer to Torah, wisdom teaching, parental correction, apostolic doctrine, Scripture generally, or Spirit-given guidance."}
